notices.title: Robot
notices.description: A robot is a modern programmable machine capable of carrying out complex actions automatically. In the present era of science and technology, robots have become an essential part of our lives. They are designed to assist humans in various fields, especially where tasks are dangerous, repetitive, or require high precision. In large industries, robots are heavily used to manufacture cars, package goods, and assemble electronics efficiently. Beyond factories, they are also making a huge impact in medical science, where robotic arms help doctors perform delicate surgeries with perfect accuracy. Today, we even see domestic robots, like robotic vacuum cleaners, helping with household chores. While some people worry that robots might take away human jobs, they actually save us from hazardous environments, like deep-sea exploration or defusing bombs. In short, robots are not here to replace humans, but to act as powerful tools that make our lives safer, easier, and more advanced.

notices.title: E-book
notices.description: English is an international language, and its importance cannot be denied in today's globalized world. It is spoken all over the world and acts as a common language for communication between people of different countries. If we want to keep pace with the modern world, we must learn English. First of all, higher education in almost every subject requires a good knowledge of English, as most books and research papers are written in this language. Secondly, to get a good job both at home and abroad, English communication skills are highly valued by employers. Furthermore, the internet and modern technologies are mostly based on English, so learning it helps us access a vast world of information. In short, learning English is not just an academic subject, but a vital life skill that opens up countless opportunities for a bright future.

faqs.question: How can I complete course registration for the upcoming trimester?
faqs.answer: Course registration is performed through the City University student portal (cityuniversity.ac.bd/student-portal). Log in with your Student ID and password, navigate to "Course Advising", select your approved batch courses according to your advisor guidance, and click Submit. Make sure at least 40% of the 1st installment tuition fee is cleared with the accounts office before the deadline to prevent advising holds.

faqs.question: What is the policy for collecting exam admit cards and dealing with clashes?
faqs.answer: Admit cards are generated 7 days before examination commencement on the portal. You must clear all prior trimester tuition dues and have at least 75% class attendance. If you encounter a routine clash (two exams scheduled at the same time), immediately submit the Exam Clash Form to the Controller of Examinations office at Khagan Campus at least 3 days before exam week.
faqs.officialSource: Office of the Controller of Examinations

faqs.question: Who is eligible to use the university shuttle buses and how do I get a pass?
faqs.answer: All registered City University students can avail the university transport service across designated routes (Savar, Mirpur-10, Uttara, Gabtoli). A transport fee is charged per trimester, or you may show your valid student ID card with current trimester sticker. Digital transport schedules and live route updates are accessible here on CampusOS.

faqs.question: What are the criteria for Merit Waiver and Financial Assistance?
faqs.answer: Students maintaining a minimum SGPA of 3.80 in a regular trimester with a minimum course load of 9 credits receive a 20% to 100% tuition fee waiver. Special quotas also exist for children of Freedom Fighters (100% waiver as per UGC guidelines), siblings studying concurrently (20% waiver each), and female students in engineering programs.

faqs.question: How do I join CPCCU or the Robotics Club?
faqs.answer: Club recruitment drives take place during the first two weeks of each trimester at the central cafeteria and club booths in Academic Building 1. You can also join digitally via CampusOS Clubs section or attend weekly open mentoring sessions organized by CPCCU every Wednesday at 03:30 PM.

faqs.question: Where are the Medical Center and Proctor Office located at Permanent Campus?
faqs.answer: The University Medical Center is located on the Ground Floor of Academic Building 1 (East Wing), offering free first-aid, doctor consultation, and emergency ambulance dispatch. The Proctor Office is on the 2nd Floor of the Administrative Wing.
